note: The places in the client that the custom title feature of Kryta.dll hooks, in Py4GW Reforged's offset format (docs/port/22-client-platform.md). The server sends this file to the DLL over the link; the DLL finds each place by its bytes, so a new client build is handled here, with no rebuild. The patterns were measured on build 39167 (F:\GW\GW1\Gw.exe, SHA-256 3aa5dcde...) at the three addresses tools/client/title_patch.py:17-19 patched, and each matches exactly once in that build and in the older build of Gw.custom.known-good.exe. A '?' in a mask is a byte that is not compared: the distance of a call, or an address.

rank_handler.doc: The handler of the title rank message: it calls the rank worker with the rank id, a pair, and the rank's name. The offset is the call.

hover_text.doc: Inside the function that builds a title's hover text: the call to the formatter. The offset is that call.

hover_epilogue.doc: The end of that function: where it goes when the formatter's text is used as it is.

metadata_lookup.doc: The function that answers a title's row of the client's own title table, which holds 48 rows (cmp esi, 0x30).

rank_call.doc: The call instruction in the rank handler.

rank_worker.doc: The function that call leads to.

hover_call.doc: The call to the hover formatter.

hover_formatter.doc: The formatter that call leads to.

hover_return.doc: The end of the function that holds the hover call: the first epilogue after the call.
